text:
lina: Starting a controlled rollforward for v3.2.1. Regions: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 23:30-05:30 UTC. Strategy: US 1% canary -> 5m soak -> 8% -> 20%. EU remains pinned to v3.2.0 until US green. APAC held for next window.
marco: Copy. Can you call out expected capacity at 20% so SRE can confirm warm pools?
ops-docs: Adding to runbook: include explicit rollback commands and quick pin commands.
marco: Current baseline US steady qps = 9.1k. Warm pool + reserved burst approx +3.5k at p95 latency targets. Thermal margin measured at 12% across GPU hosts. 20% traffic should be within cushion if we route by slice.
lina: Good. We'll keep a hard hold at 20% for 10m and run a smoke at 70% of expected slice load. EU pin remains until decrease in p99 observed.
deploy-bot: deploy started: stage=canary region=us pct=1 version=v3.2.1 id=deploy_2923456789
```
deploy-bot: action=deploy stage=canary region=us pct=1 version=v3.2.1 id=deploy_2923456789 status=rolling
```
sre-oncall: Clarify rollback policy? I want exact thresholds to automate alerting.
lina: Rollback triggers: p99 latency +250ms above baseline for 2 consecutive 2m windows OR error rate above 0.6% sustained 6m OR memory pressure leading to OOM. On trigger: post to #incidents, run immediate slice pin to v3.2.0 and start revert runbook.
nora: I'll kick off the synthetic quality suite against canary endpoints (prompt set C). If any semantic regressions >2% on eval metric, escalate.
marco: Applying traffic slice rules now. Fast pin path tested: ~25s to flip at edge.
deploy-bot: canary health check (5m): ok. p50/p95/p99 within thresholds.
marco: Bumping to 8% after soak. Filling KV caches.
deploy-bot: action=deploy stage=canary region=us pct=8 version=v3.2.1 id=deploy_2923456789_step2 status=rolling

lina: Running smoke at 70% of predicted per-slice load before moving to 20%.
```
Smoke run: duration=3m requests=8500 errors=0.05% p99=290ms (baseline 270ms) -> within our safety ceiling 340ms
```
marco: Metrics look steady. Thermal spikes observed on one host but within margin. Will migrate small slice if needed.
sre-oncall: Preparing alert policy: auto-page if p99 delta >250ms for 4 minutes. Also watch GPU mem usage >88%.
nora: Synthetic quality checks: set C pass at 98.7% match rate. Minor paraphrase drift flagged but under threshold.
lina: Proceed to 20% and hold for 10m. If green, we convene EU unpin review in 15m. APAC still frozen.
deploy-bot: action=deploy stage=canary region=us pct=20 version=v3.2.1 id=deploy_2923456789_step3 status=rolling

marco: Watching backlog and queue depth. Warm cache behaving.
sre-oncall: No alerts so far. Latencies stable.
ops-docs: Updated runbook with fast pin snippet and rollback checklist. Adding command to the thread for visibility:
```
# Immediate pin to previous version for europe slice
redwoodctl route set --slice europe --version v3.2.0 --reason "rollback-automatic" --force
# Re-route US slice to previous if needed
redwoodctl route set --slice america --version v3.2.0 --force
```
lina: Health check at 10m hold: p99=305ms, errors=0.07%, no OOMs. Declare US canary healthy.
deploy-bot: canary health check (10m at 20%): ok

lina: Scheduling EU unpin discussion in 12m. If EU is unpinned we will schedule APAC for the next window and do a shorter 10% smoke in APAC before full rollout.
marco: Note: if we hit regional memory pressure we have a per-slice quantized fallback we can enable using the runtime flag. That will slightly change quality but reduce mem footprint by ~40%.
nora: Please document fallback quality delta in the release notes so support can answer customer questions.
sre-oncall: Standing by for the EU decision. If any threshold breaches we will execute pin within 1 minute.
lina: Thanks everyone. If EU unpin goes green we'll create a separate thread for APAC schedule. Closing this thread unless we need to escalate. :rocket:
